name: dotbrain
description: Private project context, shared across coding agents and worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Private project context across agents and worktrees
interface.longDescription: Keep your project's decisions, vocabulary, working rules, and designs in a private, versioned Brain outside the code repo. Connect coding agents and worktrees to the same project context and optional Beads execution store. The session-start hook loads dotbrain's shared convention; agents read relevant project knowledge as needed. Bundled skills guide wiring, planning, execution, review, and context maintenance.

Turn this plan into a design doc and issues.
